exact_hold.name: original-private-child-identity-unavailable
exact_hold.detail: C has the original parent binding; R exclusively creates a different backing child. After R must close setup/ancestor handles and retire, namespace teardown does not unlink that host directory. C has no original child identity with which to distinguish a replacement. c8 rejects an extra child field and a substituted parent inode. A late stat is not original identity custody.
